propositions: The completion-verify agent step has no loop-breaking boundary; tool_step_limit is never set on the primary verify step, leaving RunRequest.tool_step_limit=None
A repeating tool-call cycle burns the entire step budget (240 requests) on redundant calls, producing no verdict and forcing --force-close as the only exit
The existing detector max_consecutive_repeat is inverted on real data: it scores 1 for a 4-cycle but 5 for healthy breadth, making it unreliable for distinguishing loops from legitimate work
A windowed distinct-ratio (window=24, trip<=0.50) separates pathological runs (0.042–0.290) from healthy ones (0.833+) with ~5x margin and is order-insensitive to out-of-order tool-call completion
The shipped forced-landing primitive (tool_step_limit guard) is wired only to bounded recovery sub-calls, never to the primary verify step, leaving 20+ epics carrying FORCE_CLOSE audit comments
